chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Sulayman ibn Muhammad from Hariz from Zurarah who said:

I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), 'When do I respond with the Talbiyah for Hajj?' He said, 'When you go out to Mina.' Then he said, 'When you place Shu'b al-Dubb on your right and al-'Aqabah on your left, then respond with the Talbiyah for Hajj.'

key_terms.شِعْبَ الدُّبِّ: Shu'b al-Dubb (a specific valley/location in Mina)

ai.seo_question: When exactly should a pilgrim recite the Talbiyah for Hajj according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific geographical marker for commencing the Hajj Talbiyah, distinguishing it from the Ihram boundary at Miqat. By pinpointing the moment when Shu'b al-Dubb is on the right and al-'Aqabah on the left, the Imam (peace be upon him) provides a precise ritual guideline that ensures the pilgrim's declaration of intent aligns with the sacred precincts of Mina.
